user.title: Veolia Bridge add-on
user.description: The Veolia Bridge add-on was not discovered automatically. Enter its address (e.g. http://<hostname>:8099) and the token shown in the add-on log at startup.

hassio_confirm.title: Veolia VRSI
hassio_confirm.description: The Veolia Bridge add-on is running. Continue adding your Veolia account?

credentials.title: Veolia account
credentials.description: Enter the credentials you use on clienti-vrsi.veolia.ro.

locations.title: Consumption points
locations.description: Choose the consumption points to monitor.

reauth_confirm.title: Veolia re-authentication
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {email} is no longer accepted. Enter the new password.

error.waf_blocked: The Veolia portal refused the automated browser (AWS WAF protection). Try again later.
error.bridge_auth: The Veolia Bridge add-on token is not correct.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Veolia Bridge add-on or the Veolia portal. Check that the add-on is running.
error.no_locations: The account has no consumption points.

abort.already_configured: This Veolia account is already configured.

waf_blocked.title: The Veolia portal blocks automatic updates
waf_blocked.description: The Veolia Bridge add-on could not load clienti-vrsi.veolia.ro (the AWS WAF protection refused the automated browser or asked for a CAPTCHA). Data is no longer updated. The integration does not try to bypass the protection; check that the portal works in your browser and try again later with the "Refresh data" button.

trimite_index.name: Submit meter reading
trimite_index.description: Submits a self-read meter index (only during the reading window and only for meters that are not read remotely).
